summary: 47-year-old Bryan, Texas woman suffered head injuries in an ATV accident at Hancock Pass; GCSO, Pitkin Quick Response, Western Mountain Rescue and EMS responded; she was airlifted by Carelife to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction.
